pairs.gap: Full self-attention costs O(n^2) time and memory in sequence length, making long sequences intractable; sparse factorized attention patterns reduce this cost.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: Fixed factorized sparse patterns are not tailored to long documents; a sliding window plus task-motivated global tokens makes sparse attention practical for long-document NLP.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: FlashAttention's suboptimal work partitioning between thread blocks and warps leaves GPU utilization low; better parallelism and work partitioning approach peak throughput.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: DDPM sampling must simulate a Markov chain for many steps; a non-Markovian implicit formulation enables much faster deterministic sampling with the same training.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: DDIM is only a first-order discretization of the probability-flow ODE; dedicated high-order solvers exploiting its semi-linear structure converge in ~10 steps.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: Progressive distillation requires iterative rounds of teacher-student training; consistency models map any trajectory point directly to data, enabling one-step generation without adversarial training.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: Consistency models were demonstrated mainly in pixel space; latent consistency models bring consistency distillation to latent diffusion for few-step high-resolution text-to-image.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: A dense retriever alone supports extractive answers; coupling retrieval with a seq2seq generator conditions free-form generation on retrieved passages for knowledge-intensive tasks.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: Marginalizing over a handful of passages limits evidence aggregation; fusing many retrieved passages in the decoder scales evidence use efficiently.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: Fusion-in-decoder lacks retriever-reader joint pretraining; jointly pretraining both enables strong few-shot performance on knowledge-intensive tasks.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: Greedy chain-of-thought decoding commits to a single reasoning path; sampling diverse paths and majority-voting over final answers improves accuracy.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: Linear left-to-right chain-of-thought cannot explore alternatives or backtrack; tree search over thought states with lookahead enables deliberate problem solving.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: Fine-tuning objectives have low intrinsic dimensionality, so full-rank weight updates are unnecessary; low-rank decomposition of the update matrices exploits this directly.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: LoRA still requires the frozen base weights in 16-bit memory; quantizing the base to 4-bit NormalFloat while training LoRA adapters fits 65B models on a single GPU.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: LoRA's low-rank update entangles magnitude and direction, leaving an accuracy gap to full fine-tuning; decomposing pretrained weights into magnitude and direction closes the gap.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: Softmax normally needs multiple memory passes; the online single-pass normalizer enables tiling attention computation without materializing the full attention matrix.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: FlashAttention-2 underutilizes new Hopper GPU features; exploiting tensor-core/TMA asynchrony and FP8 raises utilization substantially.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: RLHF's reward-model-plus-PPO pipeline is complex and unstable; the same KL-constrained objective can be optimized directly on preference pairs with a simple classification loss.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: DPO's implicit reward depends on a reference model and mismatches the generation objective; a reference-free, length-normalized implicit reward aligns training with generation.
pairs.label: true

pairs.gap: End-to-end pretraining of full vision-language models is costly; bootstrapping from frozen image encoders and frozen LLMs via a lightweight querying transformer cuts trainable parameters drastically.
pairs.label: true
